purpose: Permit a future research-only compatibility screening under explicitly conservative proxy assumptions where exact historical Hyro/CLEO execution data are unavailable. This proxy may identify obvious incompatibility but may not produce PROP-COMPAT-PASS, CONDITIONAL-PASS, challenge purchase authorization, or live-trading authorization.

authorities.setup_source: DH-03-HO1 frozen exact-rule 2023-2024 holdout ledger and Phase5 source binding

price_path.rationale: CLEO uses real-time Binance market data and order-book depth as pricing reference, but executes internally via B-Book. Binance 1m therefore serves only as a price-path proxy, not proof of exact CLEO fills.

commission.rationale: No optimistic maker fill assumption is allowed for a proxy intended to test survivability.

execution_friction_envelope.rationale: These total BASE/STRESS envelopes preserve the already frozen DH-03 scientific execution-cost levels rather than selecting new friction after prop outcomes. The residual above current CLEO taker commission is treated as spread/slippage/execution uncertainty, not as a claim about historical observed CLEO fills.

funding_proxy.event_cadence_context: 8-hour perpetual funding; current Hyro backtesting guidance cites 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC
funding_proxy.reason: CLEO uses Binance-based market data and its backtester uses exchange API funding data, but no current authoritative evidence proves exact historical Hyro/CLEO prop funding-rate equality throughout 2023-2024.

daily_drawdown.formula: starting equity of current UTC day minus 4% of initial account balance

maximum_loss.note: The 6% amount is official; static initial-balance proxy treatment is conservative/transparent for proxy screening but may not substitute for exact system implementation in final adjudication.

frozen_risk_grid_reference.reason: Campaign governance requires a simulation-ready exact prop translation for the official Phase3 risk grid. This document only freezes a separate proxy screen.
